newsitem.title: FRANCE: Moulinex sets 500 mln Ffr cap increase.
newsitem.headline: Moulinex sets 500 mln Ffr cap increase.

text.p: Moulinex said on Friday it expected to proceed with a capital increase of 500 million francs early next year.

"In a bid to strengthen equity and financing funds, the management board has been authorised by the supervisory board to proceed with a capital increase of around 500 million francs in the first weeks of 1997," Moulinex said in its first-half earnings statement.
It said the price and the terms would be set early next year depending on market conditions.
"The principal shareholders of Moulinex incuding Societe Financiere Moulinex have confiirmed that they will participate in this operation," it said.
